info.name: Telnyx Access Tokens Detail Records API

params.name: filter
params.description:
Filter records on a given record attribute and value.
Example: filter[status]=delivered.
Required: filter[record_type] must be specified.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Specifies the sort order for results.
Example: sort=-created_at

params.name: page
params.description: Consolidated page parameter (deepObject style). Originally: page[number], page[size]

items.docs: Search for any detail record across the Telnyx Platform
